memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: And God said, "Let there be a vault between the waters to separate water from water." - Gen 1:6 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
On the second day, God speaks again, and this time He makes a vault, a vast expanse, to separate the waters. He is carving out space, making room within His creation. The word translated "vault" points to the great open sky stretched above us. God is building an ordered home, layer by layer, for the life He is about to fill it with.

What stands out here is God's careful attention. He is not rushing. Step by step, He prepares the world so that everything will be ready in its proper time. There is a place for the waters above and a place for the waters below, and God sets the boundary between them.

This same God works patiently in our lives too. Sometimes we wish He would do everything at once, but God often works in stages, preparing us and making room for what He plans to bring next. Nothing in His process is wasted.

If you feel God is taking His time with you, take heart. He is a God of order and purpose, not haste. The One who carefully prepared the heavens is preparing good things in your life as well (Phil 1:6). Trust His timing, and trust His care. He knows exactly what He is doing, and when.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Where do you need patience with God's step-by-step work in your life?
2. Can you trust that God is preparing something, even in seasons that feel slow?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, You work with care and perfect timing. Help me trust Your process, even when I cannot yet see the finished work. Amen.
